g.text: 6,513 unique n=10 inputs · 20 search chains · 3 paired search seeds · same fixed 20,000-move cap

g.text: Frozen H3c result: supported. Adam at 1,000 vs SGD at 4,000: same observed N20 accuracy, 0.472 pp lower coverage, fitting-time ratio 0.252.

g.text: Dots show every repeated search seed (A–B) or timed fit (C), not confidence intervals. One deterministic fitted trajectory per optimizer.
